prompt: Build an 8-qubit circuit that prepares the state produced by: (1) preparing the W state — an equal superposition of every computational basis state with exactly one qubit in |1> and the rest in |0> — starting from |00000000>, then (2) applying the 8-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform (standard textbook definition: Hadamard and controlled-phase gates, followed by the final SWAP-reversal layer) to the resulting 8-qubit state. Return the final 8-qubit state; no measurement.
